description: Structured context for Barbados-focused travel, services, and user-support responses.

data_sources.name: Barbados Event Listings
data_sources.usage: Recommend events, seasonality, and date-aware activities.

data_sources.name: Barbados Tourism and Service Knowledge
data_sources.source: Project-curated from public Barbados references and domain assumptions
data_sources.usage: Support responses about tourism, accommodations, transport, and planning.

primary_objectives: Improve answer relevance for Barbados-specific requests
Reduce unsupported claims by grounding answers in local datasets
Provide practical recommendations with links and context

operational_metrics.name: context_hit_rate
operational_metrics.definition: Percent of user questions that match at least one local knowledge source

operational_metrics.name: grounded_response_rate
operational_metrics.definition: Percent of responses referencing known local data or explicit uncertainty

operational_metrics.name: event_recommendation_freshness
operational_metrics.definition: Percent of event recommendations sourced from current-year entries

policy_notes: Prefer local dataset evidence before general model priors.
If data is missing or stale, explicitly state uncertainty.
Do not present synthetic metrics as official government statistics.
Use external links only when available in known datasets or trusted Barbados sources.

response_behavior: Cite the type of source used (uploaded doc, local dataset, or general knowledge).
When recommending events, include date and location if available.
When no dataset evidence is available, ask a follow-up question or provide a cautious generic answer.
